summary: holding-wave-1's four Holdings (Archery Range, Slanderer, Temple of Hotei, Tranquil Garden) print 'Bow this card: Produce N Gold' but carried GoldProduction 0 and wire production no other way, so Producers() skipped them and they could never be bowed for Gold. The four printed values are restored. Interim fix straight to main: #434 carries the same correction, but main is wrong until that lands.
validation: Windows local: Core 1054 (including the new holding-production suite), AI 74, server 8, transport 12, collaboration 45, content 134, Meshy 6 pass; zero build warnings. Both new checks fail on the unfixed data (expected 2, got 0) and pass with it.
remaining: None; ready for review. The same data fix and a sibling regression also ride on #434.
